title: The Tallest Mountain: A Surprising Perspective
hook: Mount Everest isn't the tallest mountain on Earth. How can that be?
script: Mount Everest isn't the tallest mountain on Earth. How can that be? Everest stands at 8,848.86 meters above sea level. Mauna Kea rises to about 10,210 meters, measured from its base. This makes Mauna Kea over 1,000 meters taller than Everest. Mauna Kea's gentle slopes are a result of its shield volcano formation. If placed on Everest, Mauna Kea would rise above airliner altitudes. Known as 'White Mountain', Mauna Kea hides its true height. So the next time you think of the tallest mountain, remember: it's not just what's above sea level that counts.
